style: Shot on 35mm and large-format digital with wide anamorphic primes (18–35mm) plus one long telephoto for heat-hazed distance, natural light only — low raking sun near the horizon, flat featureless overcast, blue-hour dusk, hard noon glare bounced off pale clay — camera locked on sticks or drifting slowly on motorised slider, drone and helicopter aerials for scale, ground-level wide views with the horizon high in frame, fine 35mm grain, soft halation, deep basalt near-black shadows, palette of bone-white salt, ochre and grey-brown earth, dull steel water, with a single magma-orange note from low sun or firelight; grand, quiet, observational, unrushed, geologically plausible and unstyled, never saturated or stylised.
collage_style: Clean scientific-illustration collage: cut-out photographic fragments of cracked clay, salt crust, rock strata and dry basins scissored with crisp deckled edges, layered over warm off-white paper textures and faint grid registration marks, flat blocks and thin ruled strips of basalt near-black #101214 and magma orange #FF7A1A as the only colour accents, soft drop shadows for depth, no text or numbers anywhere, matte and print-like.
locations: A vast flat dried seabed of pale cracked clay plates curling at the edges, running unbroken to the horizon under a low overcast sky, fine salt dust lifting in long sheets at dusk
A rusted steel-hulled fishing trawler sitting upright and waterless on hard sand kilometres from any water, low orange sun raking its hull, no people aboard
A long straight unlined irrigation canal cutting a trench of dull green water through ochre desert, grey spoil banks, tamarisk scrub along the lip, concrete sluice structure with no markings
A cold grey-green inland lake under heavy overcast, ringed by a low earthen and rock embankment dam, reeds at the waterline, small waves against a barren shore
A hypersaline remnant water body of milky turquoise-grey brine ringed by a wide blinding-white salt crust with polygon cracks and salt pans glittering at midday

A deep-time ancestral brackish inland sea in a wide steppe basin at dusk, low grassy shores, distant snow-capped mountain range, glacier meltwater streams entering as braided deltas, no people, no structures
props: A single small human silhouette standing on the seabed horizon for scale only, sun behind, never a face or a subject
White crystalline salt crust cracking into polygons underfoot, with wind-blown salt and sediment streaming low across the ground
A shallow trench of dull green canal water with floating debris and wet concrete edges, reflection of an overcast sky
Rotted wooden boat ribs and mooring posts half-buried in dry sand, paint gone, no lettering
Remnant reed bed and tamarisk scrub on a shrinking delta wetland, silty channels and standing grey water
A braided stream of cold glacial meltwater threading grey moraine gravel, thin snowfields and rock above it
